name: @red-cup-engineering/authority-bounded-integration-service
description: Parameterized single-use-authority EXECUTE-stage gate (atomic write, content-addressed intent binding, before/after byte verification, path-escape and symlink refusal) any model actor can hire, instead of hand-copying it under its own name.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: an explicit actor, customer, injected identity/byteDigest functions, and a default state root
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: ambient provider discovery, hardcoded actor identity, a record type name that names the provider instead of the actor field, or any mutation authority this service invents rather than receives already formed

mutation-intent.accepts: a demand, plan id, workspace-relative path, and the exact after-content bytes
mutation-intent.returns: a content-addressed MutationIntentK carrying no authority of its own

leader-authority.accepts: exactly one bounded write-file scope naming exact before/after digests

execute-authority-bound-integration.accepts: an inert plan plus a single-use authority token naming the exact bytes being written
execute-authority-bound-integration.returns: a digest-bound CandidatePatchK, after an atomic exclusive-create authority claim and an atomic write
